name: ecommerce-root
description: This repository contains microservices for an e-commerce platform.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n "AUTH,PRODUCT,CART,ORDER,PAYMENT,AI_BUDDY,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan,red,white" "npm run start-auth" "npm run start-product" "npm run start-cart" "npm run start-order" "npm run start-payment" "npm run start-ai-buddy" "npm run start-frontend"
